paragraphs: Tiger Cavalry are Wei's unique heavy cavalry, trained at the Castle.
Their name recalls the Tiger and Leopard Cavalry, an elite mounted force that served Cao Cao during the struggles at the end of the Han dynasty.
Defeating enemy military units makes Tiger Cavalry stronger, increasing their health and attack through a limited series of promotions.
Surviving early encounters can turn a veteran rider into a more dangerous opponent. Their attacks also deal bonus damage to archers.

descriptionParagraphs: Which battles can the Tiger Cavalry win?
We put Wei's elite horsemen against the unique units of Age of Empires II, one matchup at a time.
Armies are matched by resource cost, with a maximum of 27 units on either side. Whole-unit rounding can leave a small difference in total cost.
Against melee opponents, the ranged army receives a fixed screen of nine Spanish cavalry, outside its resource budget. This gives it protection while it fires.
Watch the full journey, or jump straight to a matchup using the video chapters.
The description lists each chapter and its winner, so you can quickly find the victories, the defeats, and the opponents that interest you.
